csstools/use-logical.message: Unexpected physical inline-direction property in "%s": "%s". Arabic is a first-class RTL language here — use the logical equivalent (e.g. margin-inline-start, inset-inline-end, padding-inline). Law 03 / I18N-04 (D-21), CLAUDE.md "Four languages, no exceptions, in the same pass".

declaration-property-value-disallowed-li.message: Banned value "%s" for "%s". Law 01 bans any coloured/tinted box-shadow and the --vt-shadow-accent glow token; Law 02 bans the pale (--vt-yellow-50/100/200/300) and brown (--vt-yellow-600/700) tints on any surface. CLAUDE.md "Never use glow effects" / "Never use tinted yellow or brownish surfaces" (D-32). design-system/tokens/laws.css aliases these away at runtime — this gate keeps the source itself clean.
